title: scheduler/: a Go service in a Podman container that reads the record log, applies the routes and policies tables, runs every action as a retried job through the host executor, confirms wakes, calls stalls on two signals, writes receipts
text: One Go module, one binary, subcommands run, exec, status, parity, check. The container mounts the repository read-only and its own state directory read-write; its only way to change the world is the executor socket.
